note: Coverage gate rows. Flat sigma 0.20, S=100 (S=250 for 1 and 2 day expiries), r=0.03, q=0.01 unless stated. Live strikes have both rights quoted; dead strikes have both rights stale (counted as listed, not eligible). Rows whose outcome depends on the unratified reading of listed/eligible strikes (Q-01), of min_strikes (Q-08), of the near-the-money rule (Q-09) or of the tenor use of a coverage-excluded expiry (Q-10) are PENDING-RULING with the pick and the alternatives stated. expiry_days boundary rows follow R-13 (>= 1; bad_expiry otherwise).
